entities.name: Q11B64 bS21B
observations: The query is an exact 75-aa sequence match to curated UniProt Q11B64, annotated as small ribosomal subunit protein bS21B in Chelativorans sp. BNC1.
GO annotations: ribosome (GO:0005840), structural constituent of ribosome (GO:0003735), and translation (GO:0006412).

Sequence-derived estimates: 8.87 kDa, theoretical pI 11.6, strongly basic net charge at pH 7; localization annotation supports ribosome, with no separate cellular compartment established by this evidence.
